topic: Joseph LeDoux (1995-2014) Thalamus-to-Amygdala Fast Low Road vs Cortical High Road and Threat-Defense Distinction (Low-Poly Pastel v7)
act5_climax_episode: Circuit tracing and LeDoux's conceptual refinement separating fast unconscious subcortical defense reflexes from conscious prefrontal fear.
